prompt.content:
<video>
You are a radiologist. Generate FINDINGS and IMPRESSION from the given chest CT.

reward_model.ground_truth:
<findings> The trachea and both main bronchi are patent. A 9 mm spiculated nodule is present in the right upper lobe. Mild centrilobular emphysema is noted in the upper lobes. A small left pleural effusion is seen. The heart size is normal and there is no pericardial effusion. Mediastinal and hilar lymph nodes are not enlarged. In the visualized upper abdomen, a 12 mm simple cyst is noted in the right hepatic lobe. No suspicious osseous lesion is identified. </findings>
<impression> Spiculated right upper lobe pulmonary nodule, suspicious for malignancy; further evaluation is recommended. Small left pleural effusion. Benign-appearing hepatic cyst. </impression>
